free.note: jtj is FitResult.condition_number, the condition number of J^T J

constrained.note: jtj is FitResult.condition_number, the condition number of J^T J

multistart.sampling: one draw per parameter and start, in node order, numpy default_rng(seed). Centres: uniform within +-2 eV of the default start, clipped to the bounds. Other parameters with two finite bounds: uniform within the bounds. Parameters with an open side (amplitudes, background): default start * exp(N(0, 1)), i.e. log-normal with sigma_log = 1, clipped to the finite bound.

rule.better_minimum: all of: (1) success; (2) RSS lower than the reference RSS by more than 1e-6 relative; (3) no free parameter at a bound that the reference fit does not also sit at; (4) step_l3.amplitude differs from the reference by more than its standard error
rule.at_bound: |theta - b| <= 1e-4 * (upper - lower) for two finite bounds, <= 1e-4 * max(|default start|, 1) for a one-sided bound
rule.outcome: better_minimum if any start is one; else flat_valley if any start is one; else confirmation

profile_protocol.per_point: best of: a walk upward warm-started from the lower neighbour, a walk downward warm-started from the upper neighbour, the reported fit of the model, and 20 seeded random starts (sampling rule below, numpy default_rng([seed, model, round(10 a)])); every other parameter free within its bounds
profile_protocol.robustness: number of starts whose RSS is within 1e-06 relative of the point's best
profile_protocol.global_minimum: lowest RSS over the profile and, for the free model, the seeded multi-start
profile_protocol.s2: RSS_min / (n - p) of the model, p = its number of free parameters
profile_protocol.interval: {a : RSS(a) - RSS_min <= q s^2}, q = F_{1-alpha}(1, nu) at 68.27 % and 95 %; likelihood-ratio form n ln(RSS(a)/RSS_min) <= 1.0 and 3.84 for comparison
profile_protocol.bisection: constrained model: each interval end bisected to 0.1 counts with the same per-point protocol
profile_protocol.boundary_affected: an interval is marked when a or any other free parameter is at a bound at a point inside it; the asymptotic levels do not hold there
profile_protocol.thresholds_set: after a provisional look at the free profile and multi-start, before this run
profile_protocol.sampling: one draw per parameter and start, in node order, numpy default_rng(seed). Centres: uniform within +-2 eV of the default start, clipped to the bounds. Other parameters with two finite bounds: uniform within the bounds. Parameters with an open side (amplitudes, background): default start * exp(N(0, 1)), i.e. log-normal with sigma_log = 1, clipped to the finite bound.
